(2) The scene shifts to an indoor dance studio with light wood flooring and white walls under bright studio lighting. Two women, one in a white oversized shirt and the other in a grey tank top, attempt the same lift, laughing hysterically and eventually falling to the floor. They fall onto the floor repeatedly, with wide smiles and animated body movements. (5) The final segment shows more pairs of people in the studio, including a man in a white graphic tee being lifted by a man in a black vest. They succeed briefly before collapsing in laughter, with the camera capturing their full-body interactions and energetic movements.
